name: Bassum (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the full achievement of the city arms of Bassum (a shield with a linden leaf supported by two horses under a mural crown).
history: Municipal flag of Bassum; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bassum arms with horse supporters and mural crown
